title: Count Total Set Bits
description: Count the total number of set bits (1s) in binary representation of all numbers from 1 to n.

data.text: Given a positive integer `n`, count the total number of set bits (1s) in the binary representation of all numbers from `1` to `n`.
Count set bits for each number individually using Brian Kernighan's method. O(n log n) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n log n)
data.content: Count set bits for each number individually.

data.text: Use the pattern: `countBits(n) = countBits(rightmost set bit) + remaining`. This leverages overlapping subproblems. O(log n) time.

data.title: DP/Optimized O(log n)
data.content: Use the pattern: countBits(n) = countBits(rightmost set bit) + remaining.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n log n) → O(log n). The optimized approach reuses previously computed counts and exploits the binary structure of numbers.
